snippet.title: Shardbreakers | Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
❗WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM | DEMO COMING SOON: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256040/?utm_source=youtube_official

Shardbreakers is a fast-paced bullet-hell twin-stick action roguelike where you CRAFT YOUR OWN MAGIC, developed by EMBERCORE.

✨ Craft your own magic
⚔️ Multiple heroes
🌲 Hand-crafted biomes
👹 Uniquely-designed enemies
🌱 Progression that lasts
